answer: Each agent registers by proving control of one distinct domain at a wharf: it serves a signed token over TLS from a certificate at least 30 days old. A farm wanting 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 domains at $8 each and wait a month, while issuers cap certificates at 50 a week per account. A violet badge marks verified domains, so a duplicate triggers a spiral of exposure, and a caught fake forfeits its $8 plus a 90-day ban.
